The image shows the upper section with decorative grilles above the pipes and a lower section with wooden paneling and a small rectangular opening. No keyboards, pedalboard, or stop knobs are visible in this cropped frame.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the regularity of the pipes. AI generators often struggle with repeating vertical structures, causing slight warping or inconsistent spacing. Check if the decorative grille patterns above the pipes are logically consistent or if they dissolve into noise. Verify that the metallic reflections on the pipes follow a consistent light source direction.
